novel.justification: This cross-source compliance-ITT transport condition is scientifically plausible when the encouragement, access channel, eligibility rule, and treatment definition are protocol-invariant across sites after conditioning on the finite baseline cells. It lets different trials supply the target first stage on the cells they cover. Rudolph and van der Laan instead observe receipt in the target site and identify their CACE denominator from the target-site instrument-to-receipt regression; the present condition replaces that target-site first-stage data with a collection-wide transport restriction.
